Architecture · intelligence · belonging

Heritage
Meets Tomorrow

Homes that carry the character of place into a more thoughtful, connected future.

Explore four directions ↓
Concept render · design exploration, not a completed TRIXX project 01 / 04

A design philosophy

Let tradition set the tone.
Let technology take care of the rest.

TRIXX explores homes where the intelligence is quiet and the identity is unmistakable: thick textured walls, crafted timber, courtyards and shade, supported by comfort, security and resource awareness.

Rooted in placeQuietly intelligentMade for well-being

Four architectural directions

Distinct histories.
One forward-looking home.

Concept studies · not built projects
01Concept render

Andalusian · Moorish

The Moorish Smart Palace

Horseshoe arches, geometric screens and a planted courtyard create a calm centre for family life.

Intelligent layer

Adaptive courtyard lighting · smart glass · automated privacy screens

02Concept render

Swahili · Indian Ocean coast

The Swahili Coastal Residence

Carved timber, shaded verandas and an inward-facing courtyard reinterpret coastal privacy and passive cooling.

Intelligent layer

Humidity sensing · smart ventilation · rainwater storage

03Concept render

African vernacular · earth craft

The African Earth House

Earth-toned surfaces, local material expression and deep overhangs bring landscape and living space closer.

Intelligent layer

Solar microgrid · greywater reuse · indoor air-quality sensing

04Concept render

Mediterranean · contemporary villa

The Mediterranean Estate

Stone, clay-toned finishes and open-air terraces meet a restrained, contemporary approach to comfort.

Intelligent layer

Predictive climate control · motorized shutters · solar generation

The modern ritual

Technology should feel like hospitality.

A well-designed home notices what matters, then stays out of the way. Light shifts gently. Temperature feels considered. Private spaces remain private. Controls stay understandable.

A single, considered interface

Lighting scenes · climate zones · secure access · home status

Interface concept · no live product implied

Intelligence with purpose

A lighter footprint.
A more intuitive home.

Each system is an exploration of how technology can support comfort, stewardship and peace of mind without competing with the architecture.

01

Energy, in balance

Solar generation, battery storage and clear energy monitoring, shaped around the rhythms of the home.

02

Water, thoughtfully used

Rainwater harvesting, smart metering and courtyard irrigation designed to support responsible use.

03

Comfort that responds

Automated lighting, zoned climate control and responsive shading tuned to occupancy and daylight.

04

A considered layer of care

Secure access, discreet alerts, AI-assisted routines and wellness sensing, with people always in control.

Landscape as living infrastructure

Courtyards for shade, gathering and renewal.

Native and climate-aware planting, permeable surfaces, rainwater capture and subtle path lighting bring landscape into the daily experience.

Material direction

Craft you can feel.
Comfort that lasts.

Natural stone, limewash, carved timber and tactile earth tones form a restrained palette. Durable, locally appropriate materials are a design aspiration to be confirmed for each project.
